cheribsd.because: the first stock-purecap reading of this corpus. Until 2026-10-08 its only CheriBSD images were the poisoncap pair, which arms.json excludes, because build-cases.sh had a target named `cheribsd` that built PoisonCap and the probe's capability operand was guarded on that platform rather than on the purecap ABI.

capstone-sublet.because: the run brackets each case twice: mode 0 is the same adapter with no revoke at the nested allocator's release, mode 1 is the Sublet discipline. Mode 1 is this arm, so the cell reads the m1 row; the m0 row is the baseline that makes the pair a single-variable comparison. This replaces the 2026-09-19 freestanding reading: the same adapter now runs in a Capstone process with full musl libc, so the cell is PAIRED with the one to its left instead of being measured on another vehicle.
